correctness.rationale: The 12 hyperosculating and 16 three-term line equations are exact bitangents in odd characteristic, distinct and exhaustive by the classical count 28. Enumerating all 3276 line triples in R=Z[t]/(t⁴+1) gives 60 identically concurrent and 3216 nonzero determinants with integer norm histogram support {2,3,5,17}; hence reductions outside these odd primes cannot create any extra concurrency. Repeated exhaustive 378 pair-intersection incidence calculations over F9/F25/F17 certify the exceptional strata; the incidence pair-weight sum is 378. Frobenius t↦t^q permutes each labelled line, giving all orbit spectra and quadratic splitting since q²≡1 mod 8. Independent exact arithmetic verified the full norm histogram and each exceptional incidence+Frobenius tally; these are finite exhaustive certificates, and the determinant divisibility supplies the all-prime step.
